# @stackline/deepmerge full reference

Package: @stackline/deepmerge
Version: {{PACKAGE_VERSION}}
Replaces: deepmerge 4.x
License: MIT
Runtime dependencies: 0
Node.js: 14.17+
TypeScript tested: 3.9, 4.7, 4.9, 5.9, 6.0, 7.0
Portfolio catalog: https://alexandro.net/docs/open-source/
Security guide: https://alexandro.net/docs/open-source/guides/deepmerge-security/

## Installation

To keep existing deepmerge imports:

npm install deepmerge@npm:@stackline/deepmerge

Direct install:

npm install @stackline/deepmerge

## ESM

import merge from '@stackline/deepmerge';
const result = merge(target, source, options);

Named exports: deepmerge, all, strict, strictOptions, createDeepmerge,
isMergeableObject, isPlainMergeableObject, overwriteArrays,
mergeArraysByIndex, mergeArraysByKey, concatUniqueArrays, UnsafeKeyError,
DeepMergeLimitError. Each is also a static property of the default export.

## CommonJS

const merge = require('@stackline/deepmerge');
const result = merge(target, source, options);
merge.all([a, b, c]);
merge.strict(defaults, input);

## deepmerge 4 options

- arrayMerge(targetArray, sourceArray, options): customize arrays.
- clone: true by default; false keeps nested input references.
- customMerge(key, options, context): return a merge function for a property.
  Called only when the key exists in the target and the source value is
  mergeable. context is { path, target, source } for that property.
- isMergeableObject(value): select traversable values.
- Falsy options and hooks fall back to the defaults.

## Opt-in options

- unsafeKeys: "compatible" (default) drops __proto__; "strict" also drops
  constructor and prototype at every depth.
- onUnsafeKey: "skip" (default) or "throw". Setting it selects the strict key
  policy unless unsafeKeys is given.
- maxDepth, maxKeys: unlimited by default.
- skipUndefined: undefined source values do not replace target values.
- mergeCollections: deep merge Map entries and union Set values.
- customMergeScope: "objects" (default) or "all" to include primitive values.

## Exports beyond deepmerge 4

- strict(target, source, options?): unsafeKeys "strict", onUnsafeKey "throw",
  maxDepth 1000, maxKeys 100000. strict.all is available.
- createDeepmerge(defaults): configured merge function with .all.
- isPlainMergeableObject(value): true for arrays and plain objects only.
- overwriteArrays, mergeArraysByIndex, concatUniqueArrays: arrayMerge hooks.
- mergeArraysByKey(selector): arrayMerge hook that deep merges items sharing a
  property value or a function result.

## Security

__proto__ is dropped from target and source objects at every depth before its
value is read, so CVE-2026-93753 (deepmerge >= 4.2.0, <= 4.3.1) does not apply.
A source key that exists on the target only through its prototype chain is
skipped, as in deepmerge 4. Accepted keys are written as own data properties.
Options callbacks are trusted executable code and must not come from untrusted
input.

## Compatibility

Without options, results match deepmerge 4.3.1 exactly. The test suite
compares complete output graphs on a mixed-type corpus with ten option
variants, and deepmerge's own 4.3.1 test suite passes against this package.
Differences exist only where deepmerge 4 crashes or returns an unsafe result:
__proto__ handling, circular references, frozen options, React 19 elements,
and options mutation.
